name: Deaths, births, migration and older residents by county (Census population estimates), 2020 to 2025
description: The Census Bureau's population estimates for every U.S. county, every state and DC and the nation: deaths, births, international migration and domestic migration in the year to July 1, 2025 and summed over the five years since July 1, 2020, with the Bureau's own rates per 1,000 residents; residents on July 1, 2025 and on the April 1, 2020 estimates base; and residents aged 65 and over, 75 and over and 85 and over, with their share of all residents and the growth of the 65-and-over population since 2020. Counts only, from the Bureau's public Vintage 2025 files.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Deaths, births, migration and older residents by county (Census population estimates), 2020 to 2025 (Version 1.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23845912
keywords: county population estimates components of change

distribution.name: population-change.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: population-change.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).
